stem: Point $B$ is symmetric to $A(1, 2)$ with respect to the line $x+2y-10=0$. Work out $B$ and tap it on the grid.
solution: Let $B=(s,t)$. The line has gradient $-\frac12$, so $AB$ has gradient 2: $t=2s$.
The midpoint lies on the line: $s+2t=15$.

hints.text: Check which of your two numbers is s (across) and which is t (up).
Check the signs when you solve the two equations.
AB must be perpendicular to the line, and the midpoint of AB must lie on it.
